full_description:
The task is to design and document a practical way for me to verify the health of Epson XP-600 “smart” printheads outside the printer. 
My workflow as a service technician demands fast functional testing—specifically diode-mode and impedance checks—to catch heads that are in short circuit or otherwise in poor condition before I reinstall them in a customer machine.

What I expect from you 
• A compact electronic tester (schematic, PCB Gerbers, bill of materials and firmware source) capable of: 
 – Running a diode-mode sweep on every nozzle bank 
 – Measuring impedance values and flagging readings that fall outside healthy ranges 
 – Giving an immediate PASS / FAIL indication for short-circuit detection, ideally on a small display or via LEDs/buzzer 
• Simple PC or mobile companion software is welcome but not mandatory if all results can be read directly on the device. 
• Clear instructions so that I can assemble, calibrate and use the tester with off-the-shelf parts or a short PCB run. 
• Validation data proving the unit can reliably distinguish a good head from one “en corto” under real-world conditions.

Acceptance criteria 
1. Head with deliberate short is detected in under 5 seconds. 
2. Healthy head shows impedance spread within ±10 % of documented Epson specs. 
3. All build files compile and flash without error using free toolchains (Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, STM32CubeIDE or similar).

You may choose the microcontroller platform—Arduino, ESP32, STM32 or another—as long as it is easily sourced. Keep the firmware well-commented so I can adapt thresholds later. 

If you have tackled similar piezo printhead diagnostics before, please mention it when we start; otherwise, a brief outline of your proposed measurement method will help us align quickly.

full_description:
Project Overview:
We are seeking a highly experienced, senior-level .NET developer to build a custom CRM and customer-facing payment portal. The core objective of this application is to provide a seamless interface for customers to view, manage, and pay their invoices online using Razorpay.

Technology Stack & Coding Standards:

Frontend: .NET 10 Blazor WebAssembly (WASM)

Backend/Database: .NET 10 / SQL Server

Coding Standards: You must follow standard, straightforward coding practices. Do not use complicated, over-engineered, or overly abstracted layers of code. We expect clean, readable, and easily maintainable architecture.

Third-Party Components: If any third-party UI libraries or controls are required, you must strictly use DevExpress Blazor components. No other third-party UI frameworks are permitted.

DevExpress Licensing: During the development phase, the developer must use their own active DevExpress license or a trial/demo version. We will purchase and provide an official DevExpress license seat only after the project is fully completed and delivered, to be used for future support and maintenance.

Deployment: Must be architecture-agnostic (built to be hosted on either an in-house server or Microsoft Azure—final decision will be made post-development).

Core Features & Requirements:

Invoice Management & PDF Generation:

Customers must be able to view a complete list of their invoices.

Provide a 1-click option to download a fully formatted, GST-compliant invoice as a PDF.

Payment Processing:

Allow customers to multi-select pending or partially paid invoices for a consolidated payment.

Enforce a strict minimum payment limit of 1,500 INR (app-level logic).

Razorpay Integration:

Seamless integration with the Razorpay payment gateway.

Must follow the standard Razorpay flow (Server-side Order creation, JS Interop for frontend checkout).

Webhook & Database Logging:

Upon successful payment, the backend must listen for Razorpay Webhooks to confirm the transaction.

The system must then automatically pass an entry to a SQL Server table recording: Which customer made the payment, which specific invoice(s) were paid, and the exact amount paid.

Candidate Qualifications:

10+ years of proven software development experience. We are looking for a veteran developer.

Manual Coding Expertise (No AI): You must possess the foundational skills and discipline to write clean, secure, and optimized code from scratch without relying on AI code-generation tools.

Proven Razorpay & Blazor Experience: You must be able to demonstrate previous successful payment integrations.

Terms of Engagement & Payment Structure (Strict):
Please read carefully before bidding. By accepting this project, you agree to the following terms:

Payment Milestones:

5% paid after the completion and approval of Phase 1.

70% paid before the final project is hosted/deployed.

20% paid immediately after successful hosting, deployment, and final testing.

5% retained and paid after the 3-month support period concludes.

Failure & Refund Clause: If the developer fails to complete the project, abandons it, or fails to meet the core requirements, the developer is legally obligated to refund all amounts paid up to that point, plus a 15% interest penalty calculated from the exact day the project was initially accepted.

Post-Launch Support: The contract includes a mandatory 3 months of dedicated support related to this project for bug fixes and stability assurance.

full_description:
RevenueValve is a Wisconsin-based creative and marketing agency helping businesses, organizations, and brands grow through digital marketing, advertising, web design, video production, branding, content creation, and other revenue-focused creative services.

We work with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an experienced **Marketing Sales Closer** who knows how to turn conversations into signed clients.

This is **not an hourly or salaried position.** This role is for someone confident in their ability to sell and who wants their income tied directly to their performance.

## The Role

We are looking for a salesperson who can speak confidently with business owners and decision-makers, identify where their marketing is falling short, communicate the value of RevenueValve's services, overcome objections, and close deals.

You should be comfortable selling services that can include:

* Digital marketing and advertising
* Social media management
* Video production and commercial content
* Website design and development
* Branding and creative services
* Lead generation and growth campaigns
* Content creation
* Ongoing marketing retainers
* Custom agency solutions

You aren't expected to personally perform the marketing work. **Your job is to understand the client's problem, position the right RevenueValve solution, and close the business.**

## What You'll Be Doing

* Conducting sales calls with business owners and decision-makers
* Following up with leads and prospects
* Qualifying potential clients before presenting solutions
* Asking strong discovery questions to uncover business and marketing needs
* Presenting RevenueValve services clearly and confidently
* Handling pricing objections and sales resistance
* Following up consistently until a clear decision is reached
* Closing new projects and recurring marketing agreements
* Maintaining accurate notes and pipeline activity
* Working with the RevenueValve team to transition closed clients into onboarding
* Prospecting and developing your own opportunities when necessary
* Building long-term relationships that can lead to repeat business and referrals

## Who We're Looking For

We want someone who can **actually sell.**

You may be a strong fit if you have experience selling:

* Marketing or advertising services
* Digital agency services
* SaaS
* Media
* Website development
* Business consulting
* B2B services
* High-ticket products or services

The ideal candidate is:

* Comfortable speaking on the phone
* Strong in one-on-one sales conversations
* Persuasive without sounding scripted
* Confident discussing money with business owners
* Able to understand a prospect's actual business problem
* Persistent with follow-up
* Organized with leads and opportunities
* Comfortable working independently
* Motivated by performance-based compensation
* Able to close without needing constant supervision

## What We Don't Want

This probably isn't the right position for you if:

* You are uncomfortable making calls
* You need a guaranteed hourly wage or salary
* You only want to send emails or DMs
* You avoid asking for the sale
* You give up after one follow-up
* You've never had to overcome objections
* You expect leads to close themselves
* You need someone standing over you throughout the day

We are looking for a **closer**, not simply someone who wants "sales experience."

## Compensation

This is a **commission-only position with uncapped earning potential.**

Your earning potential grows with the amount and value of business you close. RevenueValve offers services ranging from individual creative projects to larger ongoing marketing relationships, giving strong closers opportunities to build substantial commissions.

There is **no cap on commissions.**

The better you perform, the more you earn.

Specific commission structure, payment schedule, lead ownership, recurring commissions, and qualifying requirements will be discussed during the interview process.

## Why RevenueValve?

You're not selling one generic product.

RevenueValve provides businesses with a wide range of creative and marketing solutions, which gives you the ability to uncover what a prospect actually needs and sell accordingly.

You'll have access to an agency capable of providing strategy, creative, advertising, video, web, branding, and digital marketing services rather than trying to force every prospect into the same package.

We want salespeople who can build relationships, create opportunities, close business, and grow with us.

## To Apply

Send us:

1. A brief introduction
2. Your previous sales experience
3. What you've sold before
4. Whether you've sold marketing, advertising, or other B2B services
5. Your typical sales process
6. An example of a difficult objection you've successfully overcome

full_description:
ANIMATION PROJECT – MODULAR CHARACTER FACE

I am looking for an animator to create a modular animation library for a simple motorcycle-helmet character face.

I will provide the completed MASTER VECTOR CHARACTER ASSET, original character design/reference and a sample animation showing the general style and movement.

The animation system consists of 3 independent layers:

Eyes + Eyebrows
Mouth
Cheeks / Display

The layers must remain separate so they can later be combined and controlled by software.

The full list of required animations and individual offers is provided in the animation menu. Artists may choose individual jobs or groups of jobs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

24 FPS
1920 x 1080
Transparent PNG image sequences
MP4 preview of every completed animation
Editable source/project files
Identical canvas, positioning, scale and alignment across all layers

MASTER IDLE FACE

Every animation must begin with 1 frame of the supplied MASTER IDLE FACE and ultimately return to the exact same MASTER IDLE FACE.

This is essential so animations created by different artists can be combined seamlessly.

IDLE animations must also loop seamlessly.

TRANSITION FRAMES

All non-viseme animations may use up to 48 additional frames for transition into and/or out of the animation.

This is an allowance, not a requirement. The animator may use fewer frames if appropriate.

VISEMES

The mouth requires reusable A, E, I, O, U, M/B/P, F/V, TH, S/Z, K/G and L/R visemes.

Each viseme must start from 1 frame of the MASTER IDLE FACE, perform the viseme animation, and finish on the identical MASTER IDLE FACE.

No separate rapid talking, slow talking, happy talking or angry talking animations are required. Software will control the order, timing and playback speed.

ARTISTIC FREEDOM

The menu describes the desired result, not the exact animation method.

During the active animation frames, the animator has creative freedom to achieve the best visual result.

For example, a Heart animation could fade in, dissolve, pop, float, bounce, pulse, multiply or use another suitable technique.

Eyebrows may be rotated, reshaped or adjusted if that creates a better expression. Mouth shapes may also be altered during active frames where appropriate.

Cheek/display reactions have particularly broad artistic freedom. The requested result is what matters; how that result is achieved is up to the animator.

The first and final MASTER IDLE FACE frames must remain consistent.

MOUTH STYLE

The mouth is intentionally minimalist and robotic.

The supplied design uses a single orange curve as the resting mouth/lips.

Do not add teeth, tongue, throat, inner-mouth detail or conventional human/cartoon mouth anatomy.

Mouth movement should remain stylised and non-human. Happy or playful movement can be curved and exaggerated, while angry movement should feel sharper, straighter and more robotic.

The mouth may be reshaped during active frames when needed to achieve the best expression, but must return to the MASTER IDLE FACE position.

PROJECT PURPOSE

This is a reusable animation asset library, not a collection of finished character videos.

The goal is to create clean, professional animation components that can be mixed together in software to produce many different expressions, reactions and talking sequences.

The animator only needs to create the individual assets listed in the supplied menu.

DELIVERY

For every completed animation:

PNG image sequence
MP4 preview
Editable source/project file

Please keep files clearly organised by Eyes + Eyebrows, Mouth, Visemes and Cheeks / Display.

BUDGET

Maximum project budget: $120 AUD.

Individual prices are provided in the animation menu. Where two prices are shown, they represent a basic and more elaborate/fancy result.

DEADLINE

If a job is accepted, the agreed animation work must be completed and delivered within 7 days of acceptance.

Please apply only if you are comfortable creating clean, simple, expressive animation assets and providing organized production files.

full_description:
RevenueValve is a Wisconsin-based creative and marketing agency helping businesses, organizations, and brands grow through digital marketing, advertising, web design, video production, branding, content creation, and other revenue-focused creative services.

We work with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an experienced **Marketing Sales Closer** who knows how to turn conversations into signed clients.

This is **not an hourly or salaried position.** This role is for someone confident in their ability to sell and who wants their income tied directly to their performance.

## The Role

We are looking for a salesperson who can speak confidently with business owners and decision-makers, identify where their marketing is falling short, communicate the value of RevenueValve's services, overcome objections, and close deals.

You should be comfortable selling services that can include:

* Digital marketing and advertising
* Social media management
* Video production and commercial content
* Website design and development
* Branding and creative services
* Lead generation and growth campaigns
* Content creation
* Ongoing marketing retainers
* Custom agency solutions

You aren't expected to personally perform the marketing work. **Your job is to understand the client's problem, position the right RevenueValve solution, and close the business.**

## What You'll Be Doing

* Conducting sales calls with business owners and decision-makers
* Following up with leads and prospects
* Qualifying potential clients before presenting solutions
* Asking strong discovery questions to uncover business and marketing needs
* Presenting RevenueValve services clearly and confidently
* Handling pricing objections and sales resistance
* Following up consistently until a clear decision is reached
* Closing new projects and recurring marketing agreements
* Maintaining accurate notes and pipeline activity
* Working with the RevenueValve team to transition closed clients into onboarding
* Prospecting and developing your own opportunities when necessary
* Building long-term relationships that can lead to repeat business and referrals

## Who We're Looking For

We want someone who can **actually sell.**

You may be a strong fit if you have experience selling:

* Marketing or advertising services
* Digital agency services
* SaaS
* Media
* Website development
* Business consulting
* B2B services
* High-ticket products or services

The ideal candidate is:

* Comfortable speaking on the phone
* Strong in one-on-one sales conversations
* Persuasive without sounding scripted
* Confident discussing money with business owners
* Able to understand a prospect's actual business problem
* Persistent with follow-up
* Organized with leads and opportunities
* Comfortable working independently
* Motivated by performance-based compensation
* Able to close without needing constant supervision

## What We Don't Want

This probably isn't the right position for you if:

* You are uncomfortable making calls
* You need a guaranteed hourly wage or salary
* You only want to send emails or DMs
* You avoid asking for the sale
* You give up after one follow-up
* You've never had to overcome objections
* You expect leads to close themselves
* You need someone standing over you throughout the day

We are looking for a **closer**, not simply someone who wants "sales experience."

## Compensation

This is a **commission-only position with uncapped earning potential.**

Your earning potential grows with the amount and value of business you close. RevenueValve offers services ranging from individual creative projects to larger ongoing marketing relationships, giving strong closers opportunities to build substantial commissions.

There is **no cap on commissions.**

The better you perform, the more you earn.

Specific commission structure, payment schedule, lead ownership, recurring commissions, and qualifying requirements will be discussed during the interview process.

## Why RevenueValve?

You're not selling one generic product.

RevenueValve provides businesses with a wide range of creative and marketing solutions, which gives you the ability to uncover what a prospect actually needs and sell accordingly.

You'll have access to an agency capable of providing strategy, creative, advertising, video, web, branding, and digital marketing services rather than trying to force every prospect into the same package.

We want salespeople who can build relationships, create opportunities, close business, and grow with us.

## To Apply

Send us:

1. A brief introduction
2. Your previous sales experience
3. What you've sold before
4. Whether you've sold marketing, advertising, or other B2B services
5. Your typical sales process
6. An example of a difficult objection you've successfully overcome
7. Why you're comfortable working on commission

**Bonus:** Send a short voice recording introducing yourself as if you were speaking to a prospective RevenueValve client.

If the thought of picking up the phone, talking to a business owner, understanding their problem, and asking for the sale excites you, we want to hear from you.

• Robust obstacle awareness: fetch depth or stereo data (or infer depth with AI) so the user is warned about hazards at cane-length distance or overhead.
